title: A visitor finds a business on Discover, becomes a qualified visit, presses its button and walks into its 3D storefront

milestones.title: Discover lists the business (an impression is counted)
Filtering by its category still lists it
Opening its profile counts a verified visit
Staying on the profile makes it a qualified visit
Pressing the call to action counts one press, and its link carries a click id
Step inside the 3D storefront opens the city
The city focuses the business's own building
Stepping inside counts a store entry for the profile
